<!-- pr-reviewer: e7ae538a3d4b273cf00b75653c21eed9ab47402e -->
**Review of head e7ae538a3: the entry follows the maintainer decision. It is not ready: four items to fix and the gate to complete.** Two independent reads (one of them by the worker that made the held implementation on `issue/3567-ramp-entry-max`), not built by the reviewer. I set `needs-rework` and made the PR a draft: a PR opens as a draft, and this one had no review.

## What is correct
- At a pass start whose column is still solid, the tool comes down by the existing zig-zag ramp on the pass itself, at the ramp angle of the entry or 3 degrees, from the material top plus the plunge height. The last leg lands on the pass start at the floor, and the whole pass is then cut at depth. No material stays below the ramp.
- Each ramp point is on the proved pass. It cannot get to the part wall or to a "Do not touch" item.
- The flag is set only for Outside with Waterline or Offset rings. Auto, Inside, rest machining, Adaptive, Bore and Circular do not change. The completeness guard and `RINGS_FALLBACK` do not change. No golden and no catalog program is in the diff.
- No new `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!`. The zig-zag code guards a zero length, an angle of zero and NaN.
- The pin of the held implementation (the late-entry pin at 0.00 mm2, the ramp angle, the floor below the ramp) passes on this head; `pass_start_levels` is 7 of 7.

## To fix on this branch
1. **A silent plunge stays possible** (`ladder_links.rs:191`). When the pass is too short for the ramp, `ramp_fallback` returns `None` and the old helix or plunge runs with no note. That is the fault of #3567 again, with no message. Wanted: a named note, and the fallback to the Auto order with the `StrategyFallback` warning (the note carries `RINGS_FALLBACK`), or a refusal. Pin it with a short pass.
2. **The pin cannot tell a ramp from a steep feed** (`pass_start_engagement.rs:131`). It counts only `MoveKind::Plunge` and a descending arc. A straight feed at 60 degrees, or a vertical feed, passes as a ramp. Wanted: a slope limit (the ramp angle plus a small tolerance), and an assert that a ramp did run, so that the pin cannot pass with no ramp.
3. **A replaced entry has no note.** A user who selected Plunge or Helix gets the ramp at a dead end with no message. The law of #2265 gives a named note for a stand-in entry (`ladder_links.rs:200-203`). Add the note one time for each operation.
4. **Say what the ramp is.** At a dead end about 83 percent of the tool disc is in uncut stock (41.6 mm2 of 50.3 mm2 for each of the 8 starts). The zig-zag thus cuts a slot at nearly the full tool width, at 3 degrees. That is a normal entry, and it is what the maintainer decision permits ("a ramp along the pass"). But the decision file says only "engages in a gradual way", and the pin reads 0.00 mm2 because ramp moves are not counted, not because no stock is cut. Write it plainly in the decision file, in the body and in the `Changelog:` line. Name 2D Pocket with Outside also: it gets the ramp through `pocket_over_with_relief`, and the changelog names only 2D Offset.
5. `levels.rs` goes from 431 to 441 lines (over the limit before this PR). Do not add to it: move the new lines to the module that holds the entry.
6. Draft PR #3566 adds the same file `crates/motion/tests/pass_start_engagement.rs`. Settle it: one of the two PRs takes the file.

## Gate (by the rule of #3556: targeted tests, no full heavy lane; a `P2` needs no heavy step)
The body names `pass_start_engagement`, `pass_start_levels`, the motion lib, app `offset_pass_start`, `example_catalog` and clippy on `motion`. Still to run on the final head, and to name in the body with a "Not exercised" section:
- the quick plan (it selects the example suites and `first_part_programs` now);
- app `pocket_pass_start` (2D Pocket Outside changes; on the held implementation the test `fig8_pocket_outside_starts_each_level_at_the_stock_edge` ran for more than 10 minutes in debug: give its run time here);
- `golden_cl`, `conformance`, `adaptive_pass_start`, `bore_pass_start`, the three catalog suites, clippy on the `camcraft-app` lib.

## Who does the work
The coordinator's worker makes these changes on this branch (it has the fallback and the pins on `issue/3567-ramp-entry-max`). To the session that pushed e7ae538a3: please push no more to this branch, so that the two do not collide again.

Follow-up for the test tool: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/3581.
